news.title: Philippine U15 Booters Win Four at Inaugural FIFA U-15 World Cup
news.lede: Posted By Staff Writer on November 4, 2026. Four wins and a draw produced 18 of the Philippines’ 19 goals at its first FIFA U15 World Cup & Festival, and the federation says the results show homegrown players can compete. Next, the federation wants a youth system built around local players. The Philippine Under-15 Men’s National Football Team (PMNFT U15) finished 110th among 189 countries in the world’s biggest football tournament in terms of participation, held in Baku, Azerbaijan.

news.title: Ghana draw Angola, Colombia and Iraq in 2026 WAFF Amputee Football World Cup
news.lede: Ghana’s Black Challenge will launch their campaign at the 2026 WAFF Amputee Football World Cup with a challenging opening fixture against former champions Angola on Saturday, November 14, in San Juan de los Lagos, Mexico. The reigning African champions are scheduled to meet the 2018 world champions at San Martin before taking on Colombia the following day, November 15, at Santa Lucia 1. Their final Group D assignment will be against Iraq on Monday, November 16, at Santa Lucia 2. The competition will run from November 13 to 22, bringing together 24 national teams from Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas.

news.title: Kurt Okraku, Gold Fields visit Black Challenge ahead of World Cup
news.lede: President of the Ghana Football Association, Kurt Edwin Simeon-Okraku, and senior officials of Gold Fields Ghana Limited on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, paid a working visit to Ghana's national amputee team, the Black Challenge, to rally support ahead of the 2026 WAFF Amputee Football World Cup in Mexico. The visit was aimed at boosting the morale of the players and technical team as they prepare to represent Ghana on the global stage. President Simeon-Okraku expressed profound gratitude to Gold Fields for its commitment to the team, following the company's pledge of US$500,000 over two years to support their participation in the upcoming World Cup and post-tournament training programmes. Addressing the players and technical staff, the GFA President highlighted Gold Fields' longstanding relationship with Ghanaian football, dating back to 2005.

news.title: Bail extended for man accused of fatal stabbing of nephew during World Cup dispute
news.lede: The case against the Ewarton, St Catherine, man accused of the fatal stabbing of his nephew during a dispute over the volume of a television during a World Cup football match in June was today postponed in the parish court. Twenty-five-year-old labourer Chad Campbell is charged with the murder of 23-year-old Lamar Mullings, also of Ewarton. Campbell’s bail was further extended by the court until January 20, 2027, when the matter is expected to be heard.

news.title: ‘An absolute afterthought’: the story of the Nigeria women’s team’s fall from grace
news.lede: The Super Falcons won’t be at the World Cup and with the prize money going up, they risk being left even further behind. It was a historic result in Casablanca – but not in a good way. Nigeria’s 2-1 defeat against South Africa in a playoff in August meant that the Super Falcons are missing out on the World Cup for the first time. It is a crushing blow for the most decorated national side in Africa across both men and women, one that has won no fewer than 10 Wafcon titles.

news.title: PFF lauds homegrown talents after PH U15’s World Cup debut
news.lede: The Philippine Under-15 Men’s National Football Team made a promising impression in its maiden FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival, finishing 110th out of 189 participating nations in the inaugural global competition held in Baku, Azerbaijan. Fielding a squad composed primarily of homegrown talents, the Filipinos recorded four victories and a draw in 10 matches, scoring 19 goals throughout the tournament. The young Nationals opened their campaign with victories over Belize, 1-0, and Curaçao, 8-1, in the group stage before adding wins against Macau, 2-0, and Aruba, 5-2, in the classification round. They also settled for a 2-2 draw against Zimbabwe.

news.title: Spain claim historic FIFA U-15 World Cup glory as celebration of youth football draws to a close
news.lede: The inaugural FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival has concluded, with Spain having been crowned the first-ever Tier A champions. In a competitive final that took place at the Baku Crystal Hall, La Roja secured a 3-0 victory over Czechia to take home the trophy.Spain entered the competition as one of the favourites and left no doubt as to their quality on the pitch. In the final at the Baku Crystal Hall, La Roja secured an impressive 3-0 victory over Czechia, with Tiago Polo opening the scoring in the 12th minute with a spectacular long-range effort.

news.title: Gold Fields fires up Black Challenge for World Cup glory
news.lede: Gold Fields Ghana Limited has rallied behind Ghana’s Black Challenge ahead of the 2026 Amputee Football World Cup, urging the African champions to carry their winning spirit onto the global stage.
